description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the ModuleFileParser component of the OpenMRS project, specifically focusing on parsing module files and handling errors.

classes.name: ModuleFileParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ModuleFileParser, testing parsing logic and error responses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DocumentBuilderFactory and DocumentBuilder before all tests.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the parser constructor throws an error.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfNotEndingInOmod
methods.description: Tests that files not ending with .omod are rejected.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfInputStreamClosed
methods.description: Tests behavior when InputStream is closed before parser creation.

methods.name: parse_shouldParseValidXmlConfigCreatedFromInputStream
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a valid module XML input stream.

methods.name: parse_shouldFailIfModuleHasConfigInvalidConfigVersion
methods.description: Checks handling of invalid config version in the module XML.

methods.name: parse_shouldParseValidLogicModuleFromFile
methods.description: Tests parsing a valid module file from resources.

methods.name: expectModuleExceptionWithTranslatedMessage
methods.description: Helper to verify exception messages are properly translated.

methods.name: expectModuleExceptionWithMessage
methods.description: Helper to verify specific exception messages.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToFile
methods.description: Creates a JAR file including a config.xml entry for testing.

methods.name: createJarWithConfigXmlEntry
methods.description: Creates a JAR output stream with a config.xml entry.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToJar
methods.description: Writes a DOM Document to the JAR as a byte array.

methods.name: getByteArray
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Document into a byte array for writing.
